# Pianwu · 片悟 (video-digest)

> 视频学习与创作拆解的 AI Agent Skill。学懂内容，拆出拍法。展示名为片悟 / Pianwu；仓库名 video-digest-skill；技能标识 video-digest。

## Entry points

- Human overview: README.md; English: README.en.md.
- Ready-made import package: docs/video-digest-skill.zip, with SKILL.md at the archive root.
- Installation and troubleshooting: INSTALL.md. Execute commands from the actual installed skill directory; do not assume a WorkBuddy-only path.
- Agent workflow and outline format: SKILL.md.
- Complete fictional sample: examples/starter/outline.json + examples/starter/transcript.json.
- Prebuilt sample: docs/demo/index.html; full download: docs/pianwu-demo.zip.

## Verified workflow boundaries

1. `run.py all` acquires media, transcript and sampled frames; it does not call a summarization LLM or write outline.json.
2. The host Agent reads transcript and selected images, then writes outline.json. Separate observed evidence from proposed production advice.
3. `run.py build` renders HTML, editable SVG and Markdown tables. Passing a valid --transcript JSON adds the searchable transcript HTML.
4. A replicate block enables creator/compare views. Its beat references pair with section IDs. The outline meta.mode controls the default view.
5. Image posts use a gallery outline and have no audio transcript.

## First success without dependencies

Run from the repository root:

    python scripts/make_page.py examples/starter/outline.json --transcript examples/starter/transcript.json -o ./out/demo

Open out/demo/index.html. The direct renderer uses the Python standard library; run.py additionally probes media dependencies. The sample is original fictional content, not a live-video processing benchmark.

## Sources and limitations

Implemented routes: Bilibili, YouTube, WeChat Channels, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, local video and local image directories. YouTube prefers captions. Other video routes use local CPU transcription. The default ASR language is zh; pass --language en for English speech when transcribing.

WeChat Channels needs user QR login and a third-party downloader. Douyin/Xiaohongshu full live calibration remains pending; login state, platform changes and region can affect all remote sources. Keep complete Xiaohongshu share links and xsec_token. Offline fixture checks do not verify live platform availability.

The current ASR implementation uses CPU; there is no --device cuda CLI flag. --skip-model skips only model download, not Python dependencies. Installation, model downloads and doctor network checks need connectivity.

The renderer samples neither every shot nor hidden camera parameters. It displays Agent-authored analysis based on available material; unverified claims should be identified as inference or suggestions.

## Data and deliverables

Media processing and rendering run locally. The host Agent may send transcript/images to its configured cloud model. Local ASR is not a promise that the whole workflow is offline. Model/service fees depend on the user's host.

Keep the main HTML, SVG, transcript HTML and referenced frames/images together for offline reading or sharing. CSS/JS are inline but media and SVG are separate. Changing the output directory does not copy media automatically.
